title: Florida Woman Learns Why Flipping Off Police Never Ends Well
description:
A Florida deputy catches a driver appearing to swerve all over the road, failing to use her turn signal and eventually, flipping him off before pulling over. Florida Keys authorities said Darla Vidal immediately jumped out of her car and confronted the deputy, who armed himself while being unsure what would happen next. Vidal took things from 0 to 100 as she chastised the deputy and begged him to tase her. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
